# Hillary-Marie

> Hillary-Marie is an interdisciplinary American tap dance artist, a visual music maker who tells vivid stories through the universal languages of music and dance. She is the creator of the one-woman show In The Pocket and the founder of iTapOnline.com.

Tap dance artist. Visual music maker. Storyteller in rhythm.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hillary-marie.com/): Overview and links to everything else.

- [The Work](https://hillary-marie.com/works): In The Pocket, collaborations, and teaching.
- [For Presenters](https://hillary-marie.com/press-kit): Electronic press kit, CV, bios, and press quotes.
- [Connect](https://hillary-marie.com/contact): Booking, press, and teaching inquiries.
